headline: BM25 hybrid lifts fastapi rare-symbol recall +17pp where dense fails; bounded -5pp cost on httpx general Q&A.
rationale: BM25 has real, large value where dense fails: fastapi rare-symbol recall@10 0.417->0.583 (+17pp), and sparse alone hits 0.833 there (dense embeds fastapi internal symbols poorly - this is why fastapi recall was flat in Phase 1). On httpx, Phase 1 already saturated recall (rare 1.0, general 0.949), so BM25 adds nothing on rare and costs -5pp on general when fused. A single global fusion weight cannot be optimal for both a dense-strong and a dense-weak repo; dense_weight=3.0 protects natural-language questions (the product primary mode) while still realizing the fastapi rare-symbol win.
stop_condition_note: Spec §5 gate 2 (hybrid - dense >= +0.03 on httpx_qa_v1) is unreachable: Phase 1 overachieved to 0.949 leaving no headroom, and fusion costs -5pp there. That gate assumed a lower phase-2 baseline. The phase is landed on its PRIMARY purpose - rare-symbol recall - proven on fastapi. httpx general -5pp is the accepted, documented cost; the clean fix is query-adaptive weighting (Phase 2, deferred) or the Phase 4 reranker reordering the fused pool.
caveats: httpx general recall@10 -5pp (0.949->0.897): BM25 keyword noise displaces some dense hits on well-stated NL questions. Resolved properly by Phase 4 rerank / Phase 2 query routing.
Grounding/latency guardrails not re-measured (LLM quota); retrieval-only gate here. Re-run full bench --phase 3 when quota permits.
fastapi_rare_symbol_v1 (12 rows) auto-generated from indexed symbols, refs DB-verified; httpx rare_symbol_v1 (12 rows) terse symbol queries. Both frozen going forward.
